en: A black-and-white postcard showing a waterside scene with a large brick building on the left labeled as the post office, a quay in front, and a steamship with smoke rising from its funnel on the right. Church spires and other city buildings are visible in the background. The printed caption at the top left reads "Malmö. Posthuset." and there is a handwritten code "PM 946" at the top right.
